title: Donutsmp Toolkit
description: A client for DonutSMP with useful tools and modules
body:
![Modules Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/301dfd6881dd15d7fa2aa8e19cc7c5b770f347e5.png)

# DonutSMP Toolkit
A client mod made for DonutSMP players. It adds a bunch of useful features to make your time on the server easier and more enjoyable

## Features

### Spotify HUD
shows the song you are listening to on spotify using windows system media transport controls. only works on windows

### HUD
lets you see things like your balance and coordinates in the top left

![Hud](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3051333f416b527cb0d7305501aa83eac878e18.jpeg)

### Keystrokes
shows the keys you are pressing on screen

### Chest Filter
highlights valuable items in chests and plays a really cool sound effect

### Coordinate Logger
press your keybind to save your current coordinates

### Saves
save your current coordinates with a screenshot so you can find important locations later

![Saves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6acc135354bc8871e829bdb969074dcf6942ef1a_0.webp)

### Totem Warning
warns you when you dont have a totem equipped

### Zoom
just zoom

### Region Map
we wanted to add a map radar but it would break donut smp rules so we just made the region map

![Region Map](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/069fce14166123bfaec1213eae580f136d649ef7.jpeg)

### Balance Tracker
see the balance of the player you are looking at without typing /bal

![Bal Tracker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54c95f946a3abbc7406f37626ff33ac2d0593085.jpeg)

### Ender Chest Viewer
saves your ender chest contents when you open it so you can check it anytime without being near one. note you need to open it at least once

### Fake Loot
makes regular items look like valuable ones perfect for making fake loot drops

### No Leak
replaces bedrock and tuff blocks with deepslate visually

### Schematics
download community schematics directly into your game no need to leave the server

![Schematics](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3e8e43b2b36993b86937528a53c6d97e970e70d_0.webp)

### Anti-Scam
filters trap scam and pay messages from chat

![Trap Warning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ad3d7097430270cc23aebed5c89bcaeefff6ce0.png)

## Notes
Some features like Balance Tracker only work on DonutSMP
